contentText: In this edition of French Connections, Genie Godula and Florence Villeminot continue their tour of Paris with a stop in the most underrated district of the capital: the 14th arrondissement. Calm and residential, most tourists won't make the journey to this southern edge of the Left Bank, but it's definitely worth a trip if you want a delightful taste of behind-the-scenes Paris. Here you'll find a village feel with cosy streets, hidden alleys and quirky sights... not to mention 6 million skeletons beneath your feet in the Paris Catacombs! Join us as we wander around the quatorzième arrondissement.
